---
title: "Tutorial"
subtitle: "Monday 22 March 2027"
---

A one-day practical course on **ecoFAST**, an R package for detecting abrupt shifts and
quantifying resilience in ecological data. The morning introduces the principles of the methods
and the afternoon is devoted to hands-on practice.

Places are limited, and participants are selected on the basis of a short motivation statement:
[apply for the tutorial](https://ecofast2027-tutorial.sciencesconf.org).
